nodes.name: When Executed by Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Expects either a static `file` from the booth pool, or a generated `filename`, `pdf_base64`, `office_id`, and `worker_id`. Answers status, document_id, duplicate_of, filename, office_id, manager_id.

parameters.content: One intake for every source: the Form, the console, and the AI working day. The PDF lives in the row from here on, so nothing downloads it twice.
Same bytes in the same office: recorded as a duplicate, shown on the tape, never summed and never processed.
